application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: TPO 95 A1 1x Lawson Cyprus to fell to ground level and grind out stump located in rear garden.
decision_conditions: The Lawson Cypress is situated within the rear garden of 7 Rogers Ruff, the majority of its canopy can be seen from the public highway and it has not been pruned before and as a result has a crown typical of this species. As a result it has a high amenity value and significantly contributes to the arboreal character of the Copse wood estate an area of special local character.
This application has been refused as no arboricultural justification has been provided, and no evidence has been included that shows the tree is causing damage.

Previous application (77154/TRE/2024/162 and 77154/TRE/2023/260) were refused, and within the Officers Report it was noted that no exploratory work had been completed to confirm the belief that the tree is responsible for the damage, and root size had not been determined.
